basic_info.description: Step into a masterpiece of architectural design at 1945 Hyde Street #2, where award-winning contemporary style merges seamlessly with the character of an historic 1920's industrial building. Located in the heart of Russian Hill, this 2BD, 2BA condo offers voluminous space w/vaulted ceilings, wide-open expansive rooms & an edgy contemporary design - an island of serenity in the center of one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods. Redeveloped in 2014 by Ogrydziak Prillinger Architects (OPA) & Willis & Company, the residence combines classic loft-like proportions w/ dynamic modern angles & finishes, all crafted with meticulous attention to detail & the highest quality materials.    Bask in natural light streaming through floor-to-ceiling windows. Entertain guests in the spacious, open kitchen, a culinary dream outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances & a uniquely designed island perfect for hosting. The building itself boasts premium amenities, including a communal rooftop deck with 360-degree city views, 1-car pkg, & lots of storage. Located just steps from the best of Russian Hill, enjoy a glass of wine at Union Larder or indulge in a scoop at the legendary Swensen's ice cream parlor. This home offers a sophisticated urban lifestyle in one of SF's most undeniable neighborhoods.
